title: imap: UID command variants (UID FETCH, UID STORE, UID SEARCH, UID EXPUNGE)
description: Add UID command dispatch to crates/imap/src/commands/uid.rs. UID variants are the same as the base command but sequence sets are interpreted as UID sets instead of sequence numbers, and responses include UID in FETCH data. Algorithm: (1) detect CommandBody::Uid (wraps inner CommandBody); (2) resolve UID set: for each UID in set, look up in imap_uid_map table (uid -> cid), then find sequence number from cid in current group; (3) dispatch to the appropriate base handler (fetch/store/search/expunge) with a flag indicating UID mode; (4) in FETCH responses in UID mode, always include UID attribute; (5) in SEARCH responses in UID mode, return UIDs not sequence numbers. UID EXPUNGE: accepts a UID set to selectively expunge. Defensive: UID not found in mailbox -> silently skip (IMAP spec allows this).
